title: Candidate variants with overlapping 95% CIs across five seeds
what: small ~0.6 pt mean edge of cand_b over baseline, inside overlapping 95% CIs

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: cand_b averages 79.0 vs baseline 78.4 (+0.6 pts), with no reliable winner.

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: No; all four variants' 95% CIs heavily overlap across the 5 seeds, so the +0.6 pt gap is within seed noise.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: With only 5 seeds and ~1.4 pt seed SD, more seeds or a larger effect is needed before shipping.
